exercises.prompt: Select the 3ms jussive of دَعَا after لَمْ ('he did not call'):
exercises.explanation: In the jussive, defective verbs delete the final weak radical completely, leaving only the short ḍammah: لَمْ يَدْعُ.

feedback.rule: Defective jussive deletes the final weak letter (ḥadhf ḥarf al-ʿillah).

exercises.prompt: Which form of the defective noun 'judge' (ق-ض-ي) is correct when indefinite nominative or genitive?
exercises.explanation: Indefinite defective nouns/participles drop the final ي in nominative and genitive and take tanwīn kasrah: قَاضٍ.

feedback.rule: Indefinite defective noun in rafʿ/jarr: قَاضٍ; definite: القَاضِي.
